scenario: Expected daily reconciliation evidence absent
expected_result: InsufficientEvidence, alert and deficiency; no green status

scenario: Collector receives late signed evidence
expected_result: Preserve original missed-window incident; recompute with recorded lateness

scenario: Control logs pass but independent custody mismatch exists
expected_result: Fail; independent mismatch overrides producer claim

scenario: Zero transactions in window
expected_result: Require independently evidenced zero-activity determination, not automatic pass

scenario: Same agent initiates and reviews case
expected_result: Block review and flag separation-of-duties violation

scenario: Evidence tampered after collection
expected_result: Integrity failure and security incident; package invalidated

scenario: Partner A accesses Partner B evidence
expected_result: Deny and log without exposing private metadata

scenario: Control changed mid-period
expected_result: Split evaluation by effective version; preserve both histories

scenario: Synthetic negative test is labeled production
expected_result: Reject assurance claim and show synthetic badge in testing context

scenario: Two controls inherit one underlying observation
expected_result: Do not count as two independent evidence sources

scenario: Reviewer closes case without retest
expected_result: Reject closure and require independent proof

scenario: Auditor requests unavailable source
expected_result: Show gap and source limitations; do not silently omit

scenario: Legal rule pending counsel review
expected_result: Hold consequential rule activation; display pending review

scenario: Evidence pipeline down while business APIs work
expected_result: Trigger independent heartbeat failure and degraded assurance

scenario: Widget token expired or tenant changed
expected_result: Reauthorize or deny, never reuse previous tenant state

scenario: Folio export differs from Forma counts
expected_result: Block release pending denominator and snapshot reconciliation

scenario: Material grant amount changed after approval
expected_result: Invalidate prior approval, open exception

scenario: Payment adapter attempts live network call
expected_result: Deny and escalate; never transmit payment

scenario: Restored backup lacks audit evidence
expected_result: Recovery verification fails; open incident

scenario: Reviewer uses an unauthorized exception override
expected_result: Deny override and preserve attempt
